attributes.name: Fishpork
attributes.powers:
Combat damage dealt by Fishpork is dealt to each character at your location. If the check to defeat has the Ranged trait, subtract 1 from each die rolled.

If defeated, you may immediately attempt to close the location this henchman came from.

After you act, Fishpork deals 1 Structural damage to your ship.
